answer:
Create the Step 1 INCAR file with the following PBE ground-state settings.
Set PREC to Normal.
Set ENCUT to 450.
Set NELM to 500.
Set IBRION to -1.
Set ISPIN to 1.
Set NSW to 0.
Set ISIF to 2.
Set EDIFF to 1E-5.
Set EDIFFG to -5E-3.
Set ISTART to 0.
Set ICHARG to 2.
Set ISMEAR to 0.
Set SIGMA to 0.05.
Set LWAVE to .T.
Set LCHARG to .T.
Set LREAL to Auto.
Set LPLANE to .TRUE.
Set NPAR to 1.
Set KPAR to 4.
Set NCORE to 1.
Set LORBIT to 11.
Set ALGO to Normal.
Do not include hybrid-functional tags in the Step 1 INCAR.
Run bash run_vasp.sh.
Copy INCAR to INCAR1.
Create the Step 2 INCAR file using the exact HSE parameter block provided, except replace ICHARG=11 with ICHARG=0.
Use ISTART=0 for Step 2.
Use ICHARG=0 for Step 2.
Do not use ICHARG=11 in the Step 2 INCAR.
Set PREC to Normal.
Set ENCUT to 450.
Set NELM to 500.
Set IBRION to -1.
Set ISPIN to 1.
Set NSW to 0.
Set ISIF to 2.
Set EDIFF to 1E-5.
Set EDIFFG to -5E-3.
Set ISMEAR to 0.
Set SIGMA to 0.05.
Set LWAVE to .T.
Set LCHARG to .T.
Set LREAL to Auto.
Set LPLANE to .TRUE.
Set NPAR to 1.
Set KPAR to 4.
Set NCORE to 1.
Set LORBIT to 11.
Set ALGO to All.
Set LHFCALC to .TRUE.
Set HSE06 to .TRUE.
Set HFSCREEN to 0.2.
Set TIME to 0.4.
Set AEXX to 0.25.
Set AGGAX to 0.75.
Set LMAXFOCK to 4.
Set PRECFOCK to Fast.
Do not specify magnetic moments in the Step 2 INCAR.
Do not set NBAND in the Step 2 INCAR.
Do not set NELECT in the Step 2 INCAR.
Run bash run_vasp.sh.
Copy INCAR to INCAR2.
Run python gap.py.
Return the band-gap value exactly as printed by gap.py.
